title: Hagar and Ishmael

questions.question: Who was Hagar?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:1: Sarai had an Egyptian servant named Hagar.

questions.question: Who gave Hagar to Abram as a wife?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:3: Sarai gave Hagar to Abram as a wife.

questions.question: What was the name of Hagar's son?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:11: The angel told Hagar to name her son Ishmael.

questions.question: Who found Hagar in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:7: The angel of the LORD found her by a spring.

questions.question: Why did Hagar run away?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:6: Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled.

questions.question: Why did Sarai give Hagar to Abram?
options: So she could have children through her
questions.correctAnswer: So she could have children through her
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:2: Sarai hoped to build a family through her servant.

questions.question: How did Hagar act toward Sarai after becoming pregnant?
options: She looked on Sarai with contempt
questions.correctAnswer: She looked on Sarai with contempt
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:4: When Hagar conceived, she looked on Sarai with contempt.

questions.question: What did the angel tell Hagar to do?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:9: The angel told her to return and submit to her mistress.

questions.question: What name did Hagar give to God?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:13: She called him "You are a God of seeing."

questions.question: How old was Abram when Ishmael was born?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:16: Abram was 86 years old when Hagar bore Ishmael.

questions.question: What does the name Ishmael mean?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:11: "You shall call his name Ishmael, because the LORD has listened to your affliction."

questions.question: What was prophesied about Ishmael's character?
options: He would be a wild donkey of a man
He would be a great priest
questions.correctAnswer: He would be a wild donkey of a man
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:12: "He shall be a wild donkey of a man, his hand against everyone."

questions.question: Where was the spring where the angel found Hagar?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:7: The spring was on the way to Shur.

questions.question: What was the well named after this encounter?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:14: The well was called Beer-lahai-roi.

questions.question: How long had Abram been in Canaan when Sarai gave Hagar to him?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:3: After Abram had lived 10 years in Canaan.

key_verse_text: So she called the name of the Lord who spoke to her, 'You are a God of seeing.'
